Convert an object with a mapping

convertWithMapping.Rd

Convert an external object into a giotto object using only a mapping file and the engine: parameters are bound on the object's profile, each source node is read through its declared accessor, ops or a hook are applied and the result is built with the GiottoClass constructor for the target part. A part whose source is absent switches to the first of its declared alternatives that is present; otherwise an optional part is skipped. With source, the giotto object is backed by a GiottoDisk project and disk-backable parts (expression, polygons, networks) are written there.

Usage

convertWithMapping(
  x,
  mapping,
  profile = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  validate = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  params = NULL,
  output = NULL
)

Arguments

x

object to convert

mapping

a giottoMapping, mapping file or bundled mapping id

profile

optional giottoProfile of x

source

NULL for an in-memory giotto object, or a directory for a GiottoDisk project (requires GiottoDisk)

validate

logical. Run validateMapping() before (structural) and after (semantic) conversion; FAIL stops, WARN warns.

verbose

logical

params

optional named list of param values that replace the mapping's rules, e.g. list(spat_unit = "nucleus", feat_type = "protein") to export a chosen spatial unit and feature type; recorded in the provenance and reused by readbackCheck()

output

file to write, for file targets (e.g. .h5ad)

Value

giotto object. The conversion (mapping id, version, fingerprint, params, losses, alternatives used and absent optional parts) is recorded in the object history.
